ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity light gray pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast dark contiguous regions are localized at the fluke base (peduncle attachment) and leading edges. The interior lobes contain high-intensity gray fields interrupted by irregular dark linear streaks and blotches concentrated towards the center and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression at approximately 55 degrees with a deep bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring irregular pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) that are most pronounced on the distal upper quadrants of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve fitting the leading edge from the central axis to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Symmetrical clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel groupings (barnacles) located on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the light-gray interior of both lobes, appearing as high-contrast scratches against the base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of dense linear rake marks across the ventral surface and focal barnacle clusters on the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark vertical pigment streak located on the right lobe near the median notch, distinct from the surrounding rake marks.
